dello_power_1.name: Rebuttal King
dello_power_1.effect: Return the next hit in a short counter window with an amber wave.

dello_power_2.name: Off-the-Dome
dello_power_2.effect: Fire short improvised sound bursts that travel at different speeds.

dello_ultimate.name: Tondo Turnaround
dello_ultimate.effect: Spin the beat back into a wide amber and green finisher.

tipsy_d_power_1.name: Three-Part Bar
tipsy_d_power_1.effect: Send three cyan syllable bursts on successive beats.

tipsy_d_power_2.name: Quick Rebuttal
tipsy_d_power_2.effect: Open a brief counter window and return the next hit as a cyan arc.

tipsy_d_ultimate.name: Bar Cascade
tipsy_d_ultimate.effect: Launch a cascade of stacked panels with a staggered final hit.

blkd_power_1.name: Blueprint Bars
blkd_power_1.effect: Draw a grid that marks the target and briefly slows movement.

blkd_power_2.name: Angle Break
blkd_power_2.effect: Fracture the marked angle for bonus damage. Consume the mark on contact.

blkd_ultimate.name: Kamalayan
blkd_ultimate.effect: Release a broad wave with a final all-angle burst.

badang_victory.name: Bottle and Hands Victory
badang_victory.effect: Lean, raise both hands, stick out the tongue and hold up the water bottle.

badang_power_1.name: Sneaky Manyak Hands
badang_power_1.effect: A grounded feint followed by cartoon ghost hands that pop a guard.

badang_power_2.name: Big Papaya
badang_power_2.effect: Lob an oversized papaya that bursts on contact.

target_power_1.name: Lock-On Bar
target_power_1.effect: Set a sound-ring mark on the next enemy in range.

target_power_2.name: Pressure Step
target_power_2.effect: Advance behind a red sound sweep. Break guard on a marked target.

target_ultimate.name: Bullseye Barrage
target_ultimate.effect: Send three concentric waves, with the widest blast last.
